authorization: User authorizes repeated algorithm exploration, few-shot calibration optimization, label consistency checks, and prediction-to-label accuracy verification.
scope: Retrospective within-batch exploratory study; current 171 prediction specimens already have historical research exposure.

labels.basis: user-declared workbook-origin and independent sample mapping

source_model.score_rule: aligned OVR argmax; first source class breaks exact ties
source_model.episode_hyperparameters: fixed engineering parameters from the existing source models; no inner CV with one rare-class source specimen
source_model.fit_scope: episode source only for simulated development; fixed original training role for final source

scopes.interpretation: primary seven-class known-origin-group task; all five ZY02 specimens retained in their fixed roles
separately labelled six-class auxiliary sample-size study; cannot substitute for or claim seven-class accuracy

development.class_assignment: per sorted class; source=max(1,floor(.6*n)), pool=max(1,floor(.2*n)), query=remainder
development.zy02_roles: one training-role specimen per episode role; cycle six permutations across each group of six episodes; repeat five times
development.statistics_scope: Overlapping source-only development episodes and support draws are not independent specimens or batches

selection.tie_policy: Within .001 of highest eligible accuracy, prefer lower family rank, weaker blend/strength, larger regularization/pseudocount, then stable candidate ID
selection.gate_scope: last 6 source-only development episodes; accuracy gain must exceed .001 and macro-F1/balanced accuracy losses must be <=.005
selection.fallback: identity if no candidate meets eligibility or the gate fails
selection.family_diagnostics: Choose a separate best configuration per family on first24 episodes and report its gate; final diagnostics cannot replace the global development-selected winner using prediction scores
selection.freeze: Persist all selections and hashes before any final-query scoring
selection.matched_control_guard: Apply the same accuracy >.001 and macro-F1/balanced accuracy >=-.005 comparisons to each candidate own zero-support control, in both selection and gate stages.

candidates.distance_scale: median nonzero squared source PCA pairwise distance from deterministic up-to-256 source subset

final.query_truth_usage: label join and scoring only after predictions generated
final.prohibited: No prediction-label choice of method, lambda, mixing, seed, class subset, K, or selected support draws
final.random_examples_policy: Uniform IDs chosen before fits independent of truth/predictions; display mistakes too

checkpoint.validation: Input, protocol, candidate grid and source code hashes must match; completed episode checkpoints are reused only with matching provenance

reporting.scope_of_small_shot_curves: Six-class K3/5/10 only; seven-class K1 only

exclusions: claiming repeats as new independent samples
silently excluding ZY02 from primary task
synthetic conditions labelled as real observations
